description: This source file, uploadlogs.cpp, implements functionalities related to uploading logs, including checking system configurations, reading settings, and executing scripts to perform log uploads. It contains functions that interact with system files, registry settings, and external scripts, indicating it is a core part of the log upload module in the project.

methods.name: checkXpkiMtlsBasedLogUpload
methods.description: Checks if specific files indicating Xpki MTLS log upload capability exist, returning true if they do.

methods.name: checkmTlsLogUploadFlag
methods.description: Reads RFC parameter to determine if MTLS log upload is enabled.

methods.name: checkLogUploadBeforeDeepSleepFlag
methods.description: Reads RFC parameter to check if log upload should occur before deep sleep.

methods.name: getDCMconfigDetails
methods.description: Extracts upload protocol, link, and check parameters from a DCM settings file.

methods.name: getUploadLogParameters
methods.description: Gathers all necessary parameters for log upload including server address, protocol, link, and MTLS flags.

methods.name: LogUploadBeforeDeepSleep
methods.description: Initiates log upload process before deep sleep if configured by RFC and system state.

methods.name: logUploadAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous process to upload logs via a script.
